stories.name: Biscuit
stories.before: Surrendered after his family moved; spent 3 months at the shelter, very shy around new people.
stories.after: Now goes on daily hikes with his new family in Malibu and has become the neighborhood's unofficial greeter.

stories.name: Luna
stories.before: Found as a stray kitten, bottle-fed by a foster for 6 weeks before she was old enough to be listed.
stories.after: Rules the house from the top of the refrigerator and has fully claimed her adopter's home office chair.

stories.name: Kiwi
stories.before: Owner surrender due to a household allergy; had been with the same family for 4 years.
stories.after: Learned to whistle the intro to her new owner's favorite song within two months of moving in.

stories.name: Spike
stories.before: Outgrew his original owner's starter enclosure and needed a bigger, more experienced home.
stories.after: Living in a custom-built enclosure and, according to his adopter, 'basically runs the living room now.'

stories.name: Clover
stories.before: One of a litter of unplanned rabbit kits surrendered by a family who couldn't separate the pair.
stories.after: Bonded with a second rabbit at her new home and the two are, per her adopter, inseparable.

stories.name: Duke
stories.before: A rescued miniature goat in need of proper acreage and a zoning-approved home.
stories.after: Now living on a small hobby farm with two other goats and, by all accounts, in charge of the whole pasture.

stories.name: Marlin
stories.before: Part of a tank breakdown from a family relocating overseas.
stories.after: Settled into a fully cycled 40-gallon community tank and is thriving alongside his new tankmates.
